# DPH Classifieds

UAE marketplace for cars, bikes, car parts, and premium license plates.

## Canonical public routes
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/explore
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/cars
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/cars/{id}
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/bikes
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/bikes/{id}
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/car-parts
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/car-parts/{id}
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/plates
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/plates/{id}
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/about
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/contact
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/privacy-policy
- https://www.dphclassifieds.com/terms-of-use

## What the site does
- Browse marketplace inventory by category, make, model, city, and price.
- Open a listing detail page to view the full record, images, specs, seller info, and contact actions.
- Use the public listing pages as the primary discovery surface.
- Use the post/create and account routes only after authentication.

## Content structure
- Cars: year, make, model, trim, mileage, price, body type, fuel type, transmission, location, extras.
- Bikes: year, make, model, engine size, price, location, extras.
- Plates: city, code, number, format, price, location.
- Parts: part name, brand, compatibility, price, location.

## Crawl guidance
- Index the public listing pages and category pages.
- Do not index private account, post, edit, or admin routes.
- Prefer the sitemap at https://www.dphclassifieds.com/sitemap.xml for discovery.

## Data source notes
- Public pages are rendered by the React frontend.
- Listing details are fetched from the backend API.
- Listing URLs are stable and ID-based.
